tokens.faq_1_question: How quickly can your restoration crew arrive at my home?
tokens.faq_1_answer: Our emergency flood and water extraction teams are dispatched immediately, arriving on-site within 30 to 45 minutes across our service area.
tokens.faq_2_question: Do you work directly with my insurance company?
tokens.faq_2_answer: Yes! We work with all major insurance carriers, providing complete photo documentation, moisture logs, and direct insurance billing to streamline your claim.
tokens.faq_3_question: Why is fast water extraction so critical?
tokens.faq_3_answer: Standing water rapidly seeps into drywall, insulation, and subfloors. Acting within the first 24 to 48 hours prevents structural warping and toxic mold growth.
tokens.faq_4_question: How do you prevent mold after a flood?
tokens.faq_4_answer: We deploy industrial dehumidifiers, HEPA air scrubbers, and professional antimicrobial treatments to sterilize affected surfaces and inhibit spore growth.
tokens.faq_5_question: Are your technicians certified in water damage restoration?
tokens.faq_5_answer: Every technician is fully certified by the IICRC (Institute of Inspection Cleaning and Restoration Certification) in water mitigation and applied structural drying.
